basis.governing_question: How does Banco Atlântico get its new, already designed branch operating model running in all 120 branches within one 24-week rollout phase?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the designed branch operating model to all 120 branches, with staff training and performance tracking running alongside.

gate.label: Rollout close-out
gate.decision: Is the new model running in all 120 branches, ready for close-out?

workstreams.name: Branch rollout
workstreams.answers: In what order and with what readiness do the 120 branches move onto the designed model?
activities: Sequence the 120 branches into waves using branch data
Check wave readiness with the people who run the branches
Launch waves in order after the readiness workshop

workstreams.name: Staff training
workstreams.answers: What must branch staff learn, and how are they trained before their branch moves to the new model?
activities: Interview branch staff on how the model changes their work
Prepare training content from the designed model
Train staff ahead of each wave and check what they retain

workstreams.name: Performance tracking
workstreams.answers: Is each branch running the new model, and how is its performance moving against its starting point?
activities: Agree what counts as a branch running the new model
Set the starting position from branch operating data
Report wave results against the starting position

deliverables.name: Branch wave plan and readiness criteria
New operating model live in all 120 branches
Branch staff trained ahead of each wave
Definition of a running branch and starting position
Wave results against the starting position
Rollout close-out pack against the success criterion

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, team and calendar
events.decision: Are the scope, team and calendar for the 24-week rollout confirmed?
agenda: Present the rollout objective and the success criterion
Review the scope, team roles and calendar of the 24 weeks
Confirm the steering meetings and their dates

events.label: Workshop 1: readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the first wave
events.decision: Are the wave plan and readiness criteria agreed so the first wave can go live?
agenda: Present the wave plan and readiness criteria
Review the training content and the definition of a running branch
Confirm what must be ready before the first wave goes live

events.label: Check-in: rollout progress
events.purpose: Check wave progress and open issues
events.decision: Do any waves need to change to keep all 120 branches live by week 24?
agenda: Review rollout progress against the wave plan
Discuss open risks to the upcoming waves

events.label: Workshop 2: wave results
events.purpose: Review wave results and close-out evidence
events.decision: Is the close-out evidence agreed so the remaining waves can finish by week 24?
agenda: Present the wave results against the starting position
Review what the remaining waves must deliver by week 24
Align on the evidence the close-out pack will show

events.label: Rollout close-out
events.purpose: Confirm all 120 branches run the new model
events.decision: Is the new model running in all 120 branches, ready for close-out?
agenda: Present the close-out pack against the success criterion
Review branch status and staff training ahead of the final waves
Decide whether the rollout is ready for close-out

architect_notes: The brief says the operating model is already designed, so the archetype's Diagnostic phase is dropped and only Implementation is kept.
The brief names one 24-week rollout phase, so the plan holds one phase with branch rollout, staff training and performance tracking side by side.
